reviewItem.question: For "Add `--show-history` flag to `debug helmrelease` by @hawkaii in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5505", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether an operator runs `flux debug helmrelease` or `flux debug kustomization` with the new `--show-history` flag (CLI usage at runtime is not carried in manifests or Helm values)

proposed.statement: flux 2.7.0 adds a new `--show-history` flag to the `debug helmrelease` and `debug kustomization` CLI commands.
